mapper.select: SELECT assignment.id AS assignmentId, assignment.version AS assignmentVersion, COALESCE(assignment.shift_id, rule.shift_id) AS shiftId, assignment.rule_id AS ruleId, assignment.effective_start AS effectiveStart, assignment.source_shift_request_id AS sourceShiftRequestId FROM hr_schedule_assignment assignment LEFT JOIN hr_attendance_rule rule ON rule.id = assignment.rule_id AND rule.tenant_id = assignment.tenant_id JOIN hr_employee employee ON employee.id = #{employeeId} AND employee.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND employee.deleted = 0 WHERE assignment.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ((assignment.target_type = 'EMPLOYEE' AND assignment.target_id = employee.id) OR (assignment.target_type = 'DEPT' AND assignment.target_id = employee.dept_id)) AND (assignment.schedule_date = #{date} OR (assignment.schedule_date IS NULL AND assignment.effective_start <= #{date} AND (assignment.effective_end IS NULL OR assignment.effective_end >= #{date}))) AND assignment.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'PUBLISHED') ORDER BY CASE WHEN assignment.target_type = 'EMPLOYEE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN assignment.schedule_date IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, assignment.effective_start DESC, assignment.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT calendar.calendar_id AS calendarId, calendar.version AS calendarVersion, calendar.status, calendar.weekly_rest_days AS weeklyRestDays, calendar.default_flag AS defaultFlag, date_row.date_id AS dateId, date_row.version AS dateVersion, date_row.date_type AS dateType, date_row.triple_pay_flag AS triplePayFlag, date_row.year_no AS yearNo FROM sys_holiday_calendar calendar LEFT JOIN sys_holiday_date date_row ON date_row.calendar_id = calendar.calendar_id AND date_row.tenant_id = calendar.tenant_id AND date_row.holiday_date = #{date} AND date_row.deleted = 0 WHERE calendar.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND calendar.calendar_id = #{calendarId} AND calendar.deleted = 0

SELECT COALESCE(dept.holiday_calendar_id, calendar.calendar_id) FROM hr_employee employee JOIN sys_dept dept ON dept.dept_id = employee.dept_id AND dept.tenant_id = employee.tenant_id AND dept.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_holiday_calendar calendar ON calendar.tenant_id = employee.tenant_id AND calendar.default_flag = 1 AND calendar.status = 'ENABLED' AND calendar.deleted = 0 AND dept.holiday_calendar_id IS NULL WHERE employee.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND employee.id = #{employeeId} AND employee.deleted = 0
SELECT user_id FROM sys_user WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = '0' AND deleted = 0

SELECT DISTINCT user_row.user_id FROM sys_user user_row JOIN sys_user_role user_role ON user_role.user_id = user_row.user_id JOIN sys_role role_row ON role_row.role_id = user_role.role_id AND role_row.tenant_id = user_row.tenant_id JOIN sys_dept employee_dept ON employee_dept.dept_id = #{deptId} AND employee_dept.tenant_id = user_row.tenant_id AND employee_dept.deleted = 0 WHERE user_row.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_row.status = '0' AND user_row.deleted = 0 AND role_row.status = '0' AND role_row.deleted = 0 AND (role_row.role_key = 'admin' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_role_menu role_menu JOIN sys_menu menu_row ON menu_row.menu_id = role_menu.menu_id WHERE role_menu.role_id = role_row.role_id AND menu_row.perms = #{permission} AND menu_row.status = '0')) AND (role_row.ds_type = 0 OR (role_row.ds_type = 1 AND FIND_IN_SET(CAST(#{deptId} AS CHAR), role_row.ds_scope) > 0) OR (role_row.ds_type = 3 AND user_row.dept_id = #{deptId}) OR (role_row.ds_type = 2 AND (user_row.dept_id = #{deptId} OR FIND_IN_SET(CAST(user_row.dept_id AS CHAR), employee_dept.ancestors) > 0))) ORDER BY user_row.user_id

SELECT DISTINCT user_row.user_id FROM sys_user user_row JOIN sys_user_role relation ON relation.user_id = user_row.user_id JOIN sys_role role_row ON role_row.role_id = relation.role_id AND role_row.tenant_id = user_row.tenant_id WHERE user_row.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_row.status = '0' AND user_row.deleted = 0 AND role_row.role_key = #{role} AND role_row.status = '0' AND role_row.deleted = 0 ORDER BY user_row.user_id
SELECT * FROM hr_payroll_correction WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND correction_id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM hr_overtime_request WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND request_id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM hr_shift_request WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND request_id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM hr_overtime_request WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND employee_id = #{employeeId} AND idempotency_key = #{key}
SELECT * FROM hr_shift_request WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND employee_id = #{employeeId} AND idempotency_key = #{key}
SELECT * FROM hr_overtime_request WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND payroll_correction_id = #{correctionId}
SELECT * FROM hr_attendance_checkin WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND employee_id = #{employeeId} AND check_time >= #{from} AND check_time <= #{to} ORDER BY check_time, checkin_id
mapper.sql: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hr_audit_log start_audit WHERE start_audit.tenant_id = request_row.tenant_id AND start_audit.business_domain = #{businessType} AND start_audit.business_id = request_row.request_id AND start_audit.operation_type = 'WORKFLOW_START_ATTEMPT') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hr_audit_log cancel_audit WHERE cancel_audit.tenant_id = request_row.tenant_id AND cancel_audit.business_domain = #{businessType} AND cancel_audit.business_id = request_row.request_id AND cancel_audit.operation_type = 'WORKFLOW_CANCELLED')
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(approved_minutes), 0) FROM hr_overtime_request WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND employee_id = #{employeeId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'APPROVED' AND attendance_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}

SELECT request_id, approved_minutes, compensatory_ratio, compensatory_quantity, leave_ledger_id, settlement_resolution FROM hr_overtime_request WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND employee_id = #{employeeId} AND leave_type_id = #{leaveTypeId} AND leave_period_id = #{periodId} AND settle_mode = 'COMPENSATORY' AND settlement_status = 'SETTLED' ORDER BY request_id

SELECT employee_id AS employeeId, CAST(attendance_date AS CHAR) AS attendanceDate, SUM(approved_minutes) AS approvedMinutes FROM hr_overtime_request WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'APPROVED' AND attendance_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND employee_id IN #{employeeId} GROUP BY employee_id, attendance_date

SELECT grade.currency FROM hr_employee_comp compensation JOIN hr_comp_grade grade ON grade.id = compensation.grade_id AND grade.tenant_id = compensation.tenant_id WHERE compensation.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND compensation.id = #{compensationId} AND compensation.deleted = 0 AND grade.status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hr_comp_change (tenant_id, change_no, employee_id, change_type, before_total, after_total, change_amount, effective_date, salary_component_id, payroll_period_id, source_biz_type, source_biz_id, reason, status, deleted, version, create_by, update_by, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{row.tenantId}, #{row.changeNo}, #{row.employeeId}, 'OVERTIME', #{zeroCipher}, #{amountCipher}, #{amountCipher}, #{row.effectiveDate}, #{row.salaryComponentId}, #{row.payrollPeriodId}, 'HR_OVERTIME', #{row.sourceBizId}, #{row.reason}, 'APPROVED', 0, 0, #{row.createBy}, #{row.updateBy}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM hr_leave_ledger WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND source_event_key = #{eventKey}
SELECT * FROM hr_payroll_period WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND period_id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_attendance_record WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND employee_id = #{employeeId} AND attendance_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND manual_adjusted_flag = 1 AND deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_attendance_checkin WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND employee_id = #{employeeId} AND (attendance_date = #{date} OR (check_time >= #{from} AND check_time <= #{to}))
SELECT * FROM hr_shift_request WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND (status IN ('WAITING_ACCEPTANCE','PENDING','APPROVING') OR (status = 'APPROVED' AND application_status = 'PENDING'))

SELECT request_id, employee_id, dept_id, work_date, attendance_date, shift_id, rule_id, calculation_snapshot, policy_snapshot FROM hr_overtime_request WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND status IN ('SUBMITTED','PENDING','APPROVING')
